milestones.label: Application deadline for the 2027-2028 ICP Connect call (reported by scholarship sites, not confirmed by the funder; some programmes set earlier deadlines)
milestones.source_text: Two scholarship sites (opportunitiesforafricans.com and afterschoolafrica.com) give 28 February 2027 as the general deadline; one site also notes individual universities may close earlier, for example 1 February 2027 for one Hasselt programme. The VLIR-UOS call page could not be opened.

milestones.label: Selection results communicated (reported by one scholarship guide, not confirmed by the funder)
milestones.source_text: One scholarship guide reports that successful and waitlisted candidates are emailed by mid-May 2027 at the latest.
